design.amplitude_convention: a component with amp a in A_TONE units has power a^2 (A_TONE=sqrt(2)); the equal-power grid uses a=sqrt(share) so the arm's total power is 1
design.S128: 128-sample fine-spectrum power at the exact band (head_direction.spectrum_at); a unit-power tone reads 1, so a component of amp a reads a^2
design.retention: S128 at the host band divided by the host's power share (= a_host^2); 1 = no interference
design.dilution_control: pure host at a=sqrt(0.5) = the host's amplitude inside the mixture, so its S128 isolates the partner's interference from the host merely being quieter
design.n_carrier: first PC of the uncentred pure-null state set {h(5,phi),h(6,phi)} over state_predicts.PHASES, sign-fixed onto the mean null state (state_predicts.null_geometry, reused verbatim)
design.decodability: trace-scaled ridge R^2 (where_info_dies.decode_ridge) from h_l (last token) to the next patch's complex band coefficient (where_info_dies.tone_target); nested = held-out with the penalty chosen by inner CV; null = the same with a phase-shuffled target; degenerate = the true target has zero variance (no such band in the arm)

P1.statement: every null state sits deep in the 5/6 carrier (cos>0.8); partials intermediate; surviving {1,2,4,8} outside

P2.statement: at equal total power a null partner drops the host's S (graded by null depth); trained/drifting/const partners do not; the dilution control is flat (S/a^2 const)

P3.statement: the host's S decreases monotonically with the null partner's share

P4.statement: the mixture carrier cosine rises monotonically through the blocks (most of the flow deep); band-4 decodability drops where the flow completes -- interference is representation side

P5.statement: for pure {4}/{8} the carrier cosine stays flat and decodability stays ~1 at every layer
